preconditions.description: Number of houses N is between 2 and 100,000.
There are exactly N-1 roads connecting the houses.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= N and 1 <= b <= N and a != b for a, b in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct houses within the range [1, N].

postconditions.expression: total_length == sum(shortest_path(old, new) for old, new in zip(range(1, N+1), new_houses))
postconditions.description: The total length is the sum of the shortest paths between each old and new house.
The new assignment has exactly N houses.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= N for v in new_houses)
postconditions.description: Each new house number is within the range [1, N].
All new house numbers are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(v != i for i, v in enumerate(new_houses, start=1))
postconditions.description: No villager remains in the same house.
